mapper.select: SELECT id FROM team_match WHERE status = 4 AND is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(status_updated_at, end_at) <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (match_id, player_id, status, source, recorded_at) SELECT r.match_id, r.player_id, 1, 2, #{recordedAt} FROM registration r WHERE r.match_id = #{matchId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance a WHERE a.match_id = r.match_id AND a.player_id = r.player_id )
